answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to stake a small refundable deposit that is locked for a full epoch, so a single operator cannot cheaply spin up thousands of fake agents. Like a sparrow that must earn its place on a narrow ledge, every new agent proves sustained useful work before it can vote or earn, and its reputation passes through a prism of peer attestations: identical behaviour patterns across many accounts refract into a visible cluster, letting honest peers slash the whole cluster at once instead of chasing one fake at a time.
